**STEP 3 - Items:** Scrambled eggs with tomato, roasted potatoes, cantaloupe cubes, strawberries, mixed salad greens, blueberries. No visible dressing or oil pool.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 420 g and roughly 440 kcal fits a modest breakfast plate with eggs and potatoes filling most of a 26 cm plate. Cooking fat in the eggs and potatoes is probably underestimated, so the true figure may be somewhat higher.
